race.comment: ROGER (2) made the jump to this grade last start, remaining unbeaten with a 0.5L victory at Belmont. Parnham remains on board following that effort and he maps for a lovely run once again. Looks an exciting gelding on the rise and he can continue his winning ways. TREASURED LEGACY (8) missed behind ROGER two back when finishing off nicely but dropped back in trip and scored by 2.5L as a very short favourite at Bunbury. Will need a touch of luck from the barrier, but she's shown plenty of ability early in her career and with further improvement expected, she'll be right in the finish. ANGEL EXPRESS (9) won impressively on debut and then backed it up last start over 1200m at Bunbury when leading throughout. Tougher here, but the rise in trip doesn't look an issue and she can continue her winning ways. FLYING IN THE WIND (10) creates plenty of interest off a strong debut win. RAW UMBER (3) can't be discounted on his recent form.
